title: Identification of peripheral blood immune infiltration signatures and construction of monocyte-associated signatures in ovarian cancer and Alzheimer's disease using single-cell sequencing.
summary: Full text analyzes monocyte-associated genes in ovarian-cancer and Alzheimer’s cohorts using single-cell expression, Cox risk modeling and an external GEO cohort; it reports a seven-gene ovarian-cancer prognostic profile and identifies ZFP36L1/AP1S2 as shared candidate markers. This is exploratory computational biology with retrospective validation, not causal evidence of a shared mechanism.
